# BitsnBobs

### R Package For General Bits and Bobs of Code

**Author:** Mark C. Eisler

**eMail:** <Mark.Eisler@bristol.ac.uk>

**ORCID** = [0000-0001-6843-3345](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-6843-3345)

## Installation

You can install the development version of BitsnBobs from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("Mark-Eis/BitsnBobs")
```

### BitsnBobs Package Description: –

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to use a few of the
BitsnBobs functions: –

``` r
library(BitsnBobs)
## Use dplyr::starwars data
starwars <- dplyr::starwars

## Extract and sort unique values of the "homeworld" column in the starwars data
starwars |> wizard(homeworld)
## …and paste them into a character string.
starwars |> wizard(homeworld, ", ")

## Find strings containing the pattern "Darth" in the starwars "name" column
starwars |> detective("Darth", name)
## Modify strings containing the pattern "Darth" but not "Vader" in the "name" column
starwars |> detective("Darth", name, .exclude = "Vader") <- "Darth The First"
## Find strings containing the pattern "Darth" in the revised data in descending order
starwars |> detective("Darth", name, .arrange_by = desc(name))

## Create a "retrieval" function for the starwars data frame using "name" as index
retrieve_starwars <- retriever(starwars, name)
## … and retrieve selected columns for row(s) specified using the "name" index
retrieve_starwars("Luke Skywalker", ends_with("color"), homeworld)

## Create a replacement function using "name" as index
`replace_at_name<-` <- remplacer(name)
## Replace the value in the "homeworld" column for row(s) specified using the "name" index
starwars |> replace_at_name("Luke Skywalker", homeworld) <- "Mimiland"
## Retrieve selected columns for row(s) specified using the "name" index
retrieve_starwars("Luke Skywalker", ends_with("color"), homeworld)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`rostido_fname()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/Import_Rostido.md)
  [`most_recent_fname()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/Import_Rostido.md)
  [`read_rostido_csv()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/Import_Rostido.md)
  : Import Rostido Bank Account Transaction Data
- [`as_rostido()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/Manage_Rostido.md)
  [`rbind(`*`<rostido>`*`)`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/Manage_Rostido.md)
  [`print(`*`<rostido>`*`)`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/Manage_Rostido.md)
  : Manage Rostido Bank Account Transaction Data
- [`boxcox3()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/boxcox3.md)
  : 'Function Factory' for Box-Cox Transformation of Data
- [`cat_names()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/cat_names.md)
  : Concatenate First Names and Surnames in a Data Frame into
  Delimiter-Separated Character Strings
- [`catapult()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/catapult.md)
  [`print(`*`<catapult>`*`)`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/catapult.md)
  : Catapult Class for Consistent Printing
- [`cohens_kappa()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/cohens_kappa.md)
  [`print_all(`*`<cohens_kappa>`*`)`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/cohens_kappa.md)
  : Cohen's Kappa Coefficient of Agreement for Nominal Scales
- [`const()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/const.md) :
  Make a Constant with Active Binding
- [`coord()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/coord.md)
  [`as_coord()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/coord.md)
  : Geographic or GPS Coordinate Class
- [`cor_coef.test()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/cor_coef.test.md)
  : Confidence Interval and t-Test from Pearson's Correlation
  Coefficient
- [`count_lgl()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/count_lgl.md)
  [`sum_lgl()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/count_lgl.md)
  : Count Combinations and Totals for Logical Columns in Data Frame
- [`design_effect()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/design_effect.md)
  : Design Effect for Cluster Sampling and Cluster Randomised Trials
- [`detective()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/detective.md)
  [`` `detective<-`() ``](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/detective.md)
  : Search for Pattern in a Data Frame Character Column
- [`eff_rate()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/eff_rate.md)
  [`nom_rate()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/eff_rate.md)
  [`cc_rate()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/eff_rate.md)
  : Effective Rate of Interest from a Nominal Rate and its Conversion
  Frequency or the Inverse
- [`endstop()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/endstop.md)
  [`endstop_data()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/endstop.md)
  : End String with Full Stop and no Other Punctuation or Spaces.
- [`facet_histo()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/facet_histo.md)
  : Faceted Histogram
- [`fct_to_num()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/fct_to_num.md)
  : Factor As Numeric
- [`formul_pwrseq()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/formul_pwrseq.md)
  : Expand Term in Right Hand Side of a Formula as a Power Sequence
- [`get_amortval()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/get_amortval.md)
  [`get_amortint()`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/get_amortval.md)
  : Individual Values from the Output of amort.period or amort.table()
- [`heights`](https://mark-eis.github.io/BitsnBobs/reference/heights.md)
  : University Student Heights
